# שָׁרְט

```
╔══════════════════════════════════════╗
║                                      ║
║    شَرْط ←→ שָׁרְט                      ║
║                                      ║
║    condition / stipulation           ║
║    תְּנַאי / شَرْط                        ║
║                                      ║
╠══════════════════════════════════════╣
║                                      ║
║    root: ש-ר-ט / ش-ر-ط               ║
║    to scratch / to incise            ║
║    to set a mark / a condition       ║
║                                      ║
║    ─────────────────────────         ║
║                                      ║
║    what is carved becomes law        ║
║    what is cut becomes binding       ║
║                                      ║
║    the scratch that speaks:          ║
║                                      ║
║         אִם... / إذا                    ║
║         if                           ║
║         then                         ║
║                                      ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════╝
```

*awaiting the condition*
